project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is named Empire, as confirmed in the text: "VR Resources Acquires Three New Projects to Expand Its Copper-Gold Strategy in Northern Ontario... the acquisition of the Empire, Silverback and Golden Bear mineral property (“Properties”)."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as VR Resources Ltd. in the headline and body of the text: "VR Resources Ltd. (TSX.V: VRR, FSE: 5VR; OTCBB: VRRCF), the "Company", or “VR”, is pleased to announce the acquisition of the Empire, Silverback and Golden Bear mineral property..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, VR Resources, is identified as Justin Daley. "ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS: “Justin Daley” Justin Daley, MSc, PGeo President & CEO"

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for an option to acquire a 100% interest in the properties. "Option to acquire a 100% interest in the Properties (“the Acquisition”) from a private vendor..."

primary_commodity.justification: The acquisition is part of the company's copper-gold strategy. "VR Resources Acquires Three New Projects to Expand Its Copper-Gold Strategy in Northern Ontario"

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The cash payment is denoted by '$' and the acquiring company, VR Resources Ltd., is listed on the Canadian TSX Venture Exchange (TSX.V), implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The project's share is $16,666.67, calculated as one-third of the total $50,000 cash payment ($45,000 initial + $5,000 second payment) for the three properties (Empire, Silverback, and Golden Bear) as stated in the terms: 'initial payment of $45,000... The remaining 10% interest can be acquired by a second payment of $5,000'.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.
